blocks.text: Hypothesis
Hypothesis ek aisa bayan ya assumption hai jise test kiya ja sake, kisi population (abadi), surat-e-haal ya variables ke rishte ke baare mein.
Hypothesis testing
Hypothesis testing statistics ka tareeqa hai jo tay karta hai ke sample data mein kisi daawe ko support ya reject karne ke liye kafi saboot hai ya nahi.
Null hypothesis
Null hypothesis, jise H₀ likhte hain, kehta hai ke variables mein koi numayan farq, asar ya rishta nahi.
Alternative hypothesis
Alternative hypothesis, jise H₁ ya Hₐ likhte hain, kehta hai ke variables mein numayan farq, asar ya rishta hai.
Test statistic
Test statistic sample data se nikla number hai jis se hypothesis testing mein faisla hota hai. Misalein: z, t aur F values.
Critical region
Critical region statistical distribution ka woh hissa hai jahan null hypothesis reject hota hai.
Significance level
Significance level, jise α (alpha) likhte hain, null hypothesis ko sach hote hue bhi reject kar dene ki zyada se zyada probability hai. Aam qeemat 0.05 hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yahan alpha ki alamat ko typesetting code "(\alpha)" ki shakal mein chhapti hai, aur H₀, H₁, Hₐ ko (H_0), (H_1), (H_a). Sahi alamatein α, H₀, H₁ aur Hₐ hain.
p-value
p-value batati hai ke agar null hypothesis sach ho to yahi nateeja, ya is se zyada intehai nateeja, milne ki probability kitni hai. Chhoti p-value null hypothesis ke khilaf saboot hai.
Decision rule (faisle ka qaida)
Decision rule se tay hota hai ke null hypothesis reject ho ya reject na ho. Maslan agar p-value < α ho to null hypothesis reject hota hai.
Data visualisation
Data visualization graphs, charts aur diagrams se data ko wazeh pesh karna hai, taake hypothesis testing ke nataij samajhne mein madad mile.
Bias (janibdari)
Bias data jama karne, analysis ya tashreeh mein na-munsifana asar hai jo ghalat ya gumraah-kun nateejon tak le ja sakta hai.
Data ka akhlaqi istemal
Data ka akhlaqi istemal yeh hai ke data imandari, insaf aur zimmedari se jama, analyze aur report kiya jaye, privacy bachai jaye aur ghalat istemal na ho.
Nataij batana (communicating results)
Nataij batane ka matlab hai unhein wazeh, durust aur asal hypothesis ke hawale se pesh karna, taake parhne wale nateeja samajh sakein.
Mukhtasar khulasa

items: H₀ banam H₁; test statistic; critical region; α; p-value; p < α ho to H₀ reject.
